ingredients.name: 3'-Sialyllactose (3'-SL)
ingredients.mechanismBasis: As a human milk oligosaccharide (HMO)-derived ingredient, 3'-SL is being explored for its potential to strengthen the gut mucosal barrier, help modulate the gut microbiome, and help reduce inflammation, based on the known mechanism of HMOs and structural rationale.

clinicalEvidence.summary: No in-house clinical trial data is currently available for 3'-SL.
clinicalEvidence.details: Statements about gut and joint health are based on the mechanism of HMOs and structural rationale only, using language such as 'exploring the potential of' and 'based on the mechanism of.' They should not be interpreted as proven clinical efficacy.

patentStatus.note: Covered under GeneChem's sialyllactose composition patents (specific patent numbers to be confirmed).

ingredients.businessScope: overseas / export only — not available for the domestic Korean market

ingredients.name: 6'-Sialyllactose (6'-SL)

clinicalEvidence.summary: Clinical and research data support 6'-SL's role in muscle physiology, including a rare-disease pilot trial in GNE myopathy patients and a POSTECH collaborative exercise-performance study.

studies.name: GNE Myopathy Pilot Clinical Trial
studies.population: patients with GNE myopathy, a rare genetic muscle disease
studies.results: Free sialic acid levels increased significantly from baseline in both dose groups after 12 weeks. At 96 weeks, the high-dose group showed improving trends in motor function measures, such as hand grip strength and hip flexion.
studies.disclaimer: These results reflect a rare-disease patient population (GNE myopathy) and should not be generalized as muscle-building efficacy claims for the general healthy population or typical sports nutrition consumers.

studies.name: POSTECH Collaborative Study
studies.population: Exercise performance and muscle strength study
studies.design: Collaborative research with Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)
studies.results: demonstrated a measurable effect on exercise performance and muscle strength.

ingredients.name: AquaGG

mechanism.target: Aquaporin-3 (AQP3), the key water channel protein in skin cells
effects: deep, long-lasting hydration for a dewy, radiant complexion
supported collagen/elastin production for improved elasticity

ingredients.originStory: inspired by the Resurrection Plant's ability to retain moisture and stay hydrated under extreme drought conditions.

clinicalEvidence.summary: AQP3 activation and hydration efficacy have been scientifically confirmed.
